title: Vector3 reference construction
summary: Recovered 0x426f00: ordered representation copies from three float references to offsets 0/4/8, then zero at offset 12; thiscall, returns this, callee pops 12 bytes. A genuine member method exposes the constructor-shaped entry's return value. Inspected original callers use addresses of float locals and vector component indexing.
test_description: Compare original and recovered member calls across 12 float bit-pattern seeds, all 125 aligned destination/external argument alias combinations, and four MXCSR modes (6000 calls). Assert returned destination, complete guarded storage equality, positive-zero fourth word, unchanged external inputs, guards and MXCSR. Includes signed zeros, infinities, quiet/signaling NaNs, subnormals and finite extremes.
known_limits: Original source type and member names unavailable; float vector interpretation is supported by callers. Fourth word's wider semantic role is unknown.
Invalid/null references, inaccessible memory and misaligned or partially overlapping float objects are outside portable C++ object semantics and are not dynamically tested.
No byte-matching claim. Member method represents constructor behavior while exposing its machine return value.
